description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: The writer sets out an orderly account for Theophilus. The angel Gabriel announces the birth of John to Zechariah in the temple and the birth of Jesus to Mary in Nazareth; Mary visits Elizabeth and praises God, and at John's birth Zechariah blesses the God of Israel.
1.sw: Mwandishi anaandaa simulizi lenye mpangilio kwa ajili ya Theofilo. Malaika Gabrieli anatangaza kuzaliwa kwa Yohana kwa Zakaria hekaluni, na kuzaliwa kwa Yesu kwa Mariamu huko Nazareti; Mariamu anamtembelea Elisabeti na kumsifu Mungu, na Yohana anapozaliwa Zakaria anamhimidi Mungu wa Israeli.
1.am: ጸሐፊው ለቴዎፍሎስ በቅደም ተከተል የተዘጋጀ ዘገባ ያቀርባል። መልአኩ ገብርኤል የዮሐንስን መወለድ በቤተ መቅደስ ለዘካርያስ፣ የኢየሱስንም መወለድ በናዝሬት ለማርያም ያበሥራል፤ ማርያም ኤልሳቤጥን ትጎበኛለች፣ እግዚአብሔርንም ታመሰግናለች፤ ዮሐንስ ሲወለድም ዘካርያስ የእስራኤልን አምላክ ይባርካል።

2.en: Jesus is born in Bethlehem, the town of David, and angels bring the good news to shepherds. Presented in the temple, the child is welcomed by Simeon and Anna, and at twelve Jesus stays behind in the temple, in the Father's house.
2.sw: Yesu anazaliwa Bethlehemu, mji wa Daudi, na malaika wanawaletea wachungaji habari njema. Anapoletwa hekaluni, mtoto anapokelewa na Simeoni na Ana, na akiwa na miaka kumi na miwili Yesu anabaki nyuma hekaluni, katika nyumba ya Baba.
2.am: ኢየሱስ በዳዊት ከተማ በቤተ ልሔም ይወለዳል፤ መላእክትም ለእረኞች የምሥራቹን ያመጣሉ። ሕፃኑ በቤተ መቅደስ በቀረበ ጊዜ ስምዖንና ሐና ይቀበሉታል፤ ኢየሱስም በዐሥራ ሁለት ዓመቱ በአብ ቤት በቤተ መቅደስ ይቀራል።

3.en: The word of God comes to John in the wilderness, who calls the crowds to bear fruit that shows repentance and promises one stronger than himself. The Spirit comes down on Jesus at baptism, and Jesus's family line is traced back to Adam.
3.sw: Neno la Mungu linamjia Yohana nyikani, naye anaita makundi ya watu kuzaa matunda yanayoonyesha toba, na kuahidi mmoja aliye na nguvu kuliko yeye. Roho anashuka juu ya Yesu wakati wa ubatizo, na ukoo wa Yesu unafuatiliwa hadi kwa Adamu.
3.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በምድረ በዳ ወደ ዮሐንስ ይመጣል፤ እርሱም ሕዝቡን ለንስሓ የሚገባ ፍሬ እንዲያፈሩ ይጠራል፣ ከእርሱም የሚበልጥ ብርቱ እንደሚመጣ ተስፋ ይሰጣል። በጥምቀቱ ጊዜ መንፈስ በኢየሱስ ላይ ይወርዳል፤ የኢየሱስም የትውልድ ሐረግ እስከ አዳም ድረስ ይዘረዘራል።

4.en: The devil tests Jesus in the wilderness. In the synagogue at Nazareth Jesus reads from Isaiah and is driven out of town; in Capernaum Jesus drives out an unclean spirit, heals Simon's mother-in-law and many others, and goes on to bring the good news to other towns.
4.sw: Ibilisi anamjaribu Yesu nyikani. Katika sinagogi la Nazareti Yesu anasoma kutoka kitabu cha Isaya na kufukuzwa mjini; huko Kapernaumu Yesu anafukuza pepo mchafu, anamponya mama mkwe wa Simoni na wengine wengi, na kuendelea kupeleka habari njema katika miji mingine.
4.am: ዲያብሎስ ኢየሱስን በምድረ በዳ ይፈትነዋል። በናዝሬት ምኩራብ ኢየሱስ ከኢሳይያስ መጽሐፍ ያነብባል፤ ከከተማውም ይባረራል። በቅፍርናሆም ኢየሱስ ርኩስ መንፈስን ያስወጣል፣ የስምዖንን አማትና ሌሎች ብዙዎችን ይፈውሳል፣ ወደ ሌሎች ከተሞችም የምሥራቹን ለማድረስ ይሄዳል።

5.en: After a great catch of fish Simon and his partners leave everything to follow Jesus. Jesus makes a man with leprosy clean, forgives and heals a paralyzed man, calls Levi from his tax booth and answers a question about fasting with sayings about the bridegroom, patches and wineskins.
5.sw: Baada ya kuvua samaki wengi mno, Simoni na wenzake wanaacha kila kitu na kumfuata Yesu. Yesu anamtakasa mtu mwenye ukoma, anamsamehe na kumponya mtu aliyepooza, anamwita Lawi kutoka kibanda chake cha ushuru na kujibu swali kuhusu kufunga kwa misemo kuhusu bwana arusi, viraka na viriba vya divai.
5.am: ስምዖንና ባልንጀሮቹ እጅግ ብዙ ዓሣ ካጠመዱ በኋላ ሁሉን ትተው ኢየሱስን ይከተሉታል። ኢየሱስ ለምጽ የያዘውን ሰው ያነጻል፣ ሽባውን ይቅር ብሎ ይፈውሳል፣ ሌዊን ከቀረጥ ቢሮው ይጠራል፤ ስለ ጾም ለቀረበለት ጥያቄም ስለ ሙሽራው፣ ስለ ዕራፊና ስለ ወይን አቁማዳ በሚናገሩ አባባሎች ይመልሳል።

6.en: Jesus is challenged over the Sabbath and heals a withered hand, then chooses the twelve. In a sermon to the crowds Jesus blesses the poor, warns the rich, commands love for enemies and ends with the builder who sets a house on rock.
6.sw: Yesu anapingwa kuhusu Sabato na kuponya mkono uliopooza, kisha anawachagua wale kumi na wawili. Katika hotuba kwa makundi ya watu Yesu anawabariki maskini, anawaonya matajiri, anaamuru upendo kwa adui na kumalizia na mjenzi anayeweka nyumba juu ya mwamba.
6.am: ኢየሱስ ስለ ሰንበት ይከሰሳል፤ የሰለለች እጅንም ይፈውሳል፤ ከዚያም አሥራ ሁለቱን ይመርጣል። ለሕዝቡ በሰጠው ስብከት ኢየሱስ ድሆችን ይባርካል፣ ሀብታሞችን ያስጠነቅቃል፣ ጠላትን መውደድን ያዝዛል፣ ቤቱን በዓለት ላይ በሚሠራው ሰውም ይደመድማል።

7.en: Jesus heals a centurion's servant and raises a widow's son at Nain. Jesus answers John's question and speaks about John, and at a Pharisee's table a woman with an alabaster flask is forgiven much and loves much.
7.sw: Yesu anamponya mtumishi wa akida na kumfufua mwana wa mjane huko Naini. Yesu anajibu swali la Yohana na kuzungumza kuhusu Yohana, na mezani kwa Farisayo mmoja mwanamke mwenye chupa ya alabasta anasamehewa mengi na kupenda sana.
7.am: ኢየሱስ የመቶ አለቃውን አገልጋይ ይፈውሳል፤ በናይንም የመበለቲቱን ልጅ ከሞት ያስነሣል። ኢየሱስ ለዮሐንስ ጥያቄ መልስ ይሰጣል፣ ስለ ዮሐንስም ይናገራል፤ በአንድ ፈሪሳዊ ማዕድ ላይ የአልባስጥሮስ ብልቃጥ የያዘች ሴት ብዙ ኃጢአቷ ይቅር ይባልላታል፣ እርሷም እጅግ ትወዳለች።

8.en: Women who traveled with Jesus support the work. Jesus tells the parable of the sower and of the lamp, calms the wind and the water, frees a man from many demons, heals a woman who touched Jesus's clothes and raises the daughter of Jairus.
8.sw: Wanawake waliosafiri pamoja na Yesu wanaitegemeza kazi. Yesu anatoa mfano wa mpanzi na wa taa, anatuliza upepo na maji, anamweka huru mtu kutoka kwa pepo wengi, anamponya mwanamke aliyegusa mavazi ya Yesu na kumfufua binti wa Yairo.
8.am: ከኢየሱስ ጋር የሚጓዙ ሴቶች ሥራውን ይደግፋሉ። ኢየሱስ የዘሪውንና የመብራቱን ምሳሌ ይናገራል፣ ነፋሱንና ውኃውን ጸጥ ያሰኛል፣ ብዙ አጋንንት ያደሩበትን ሰው ነጻ ያወጣል፣ የኢየሱስን ልብስ የነካችውን ሴት ይፈውሳል፣ የኢያኢሮስንም ልጅ ከሞት ያስነሣል።

9.en: Jesus sends out the Twelve and feeds five thousand, and Peter says who Jesus is. Jesus speaks of the cross, is changed in appearance on the mountain, frees a boy from a spirit, and sets out for Jerusalem; a Samaritan village turns Jesus away.
9.sw: Yesu anawatuma Kumi na Wawili na kulisha watu elfu tano, naye Petro anasema Yesu ni nani. Yesu anazungumza kuhusu msalaba, anabadilika sura mlimani, anamweka huru kijana kutoka kwa pepo, na kuanza safari kwenda Yerusalemu; kijiji kimoja cha Wasamaria kinamkataa Yesu.
9.am: ኢየሱስ አሥራ ሁለቱን ይልካል፣ አምስት ሺህ ሰዎችንም ይመግባል፤ ጴጥሮስም ኢየሱስ ማን እንደ ሆነ ይናገራል። ኢየሱስ ስለ መስቀል ይናገራል፣ በተራራ ላይ መልኩ ይለወጣል፣ ልጁን ከመንፈስ ነጻ ያወጣል፣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ጉዞ ይጀምራል፤ አንዲት የሳምራውያን መንደር ኢየሱስን አትቀበለውም።

10.en: Jesus sends seventy-two ahead in pairs, and they come back rejoicing. Answering an expert in the law, Jesus tells of a Samaritan who stops to help a wounded man, and at the house of Martha and Mary praises Mary for listening.
10.sw: Yesu anawatuma sabini na wawili wawili wawili watangulie, nao wanarudi wakifurahi. Akimjibu mtaalamu wa sheria, Yesu anasimulia habari ya Msamaria anayesimama kumsaidia mtu aliyejeruhiwa, na nyumbani kwa Martha na Mariamu anamsifu Mariamu kwa kusikiliza.
10.am: ኢየሱስ ሰባ ሁለት ሰዎችን ሁለት ሁለት አድርጎ ቀድመውት እንዲሄዱ ይልካል፤ እነርሱም ደስ እያላቸው ይመለሳሉ። ኢየሱስ ለሕግ አዋቂው ሲመልስ የቈሰለውን ሰው ለመርዳት ስለ ቆመው ሳምራዊ ይናገራል፤ በማርታና በማርያም ቤትም ማርያምን ስለ ማዳመጧ ያመሰግናታል።

11.en: Jesus teaches the disciples to pray and urges them to ask, search and knock. Accused of driving out demons by Beelzebul, Jesus speaks of the finger of God and the sign of Jonah, and denounces the Pharisees and the experts in the law at a meal.
11.sw: Yesu anawafundisha wanafunzi kuomba na kuwahimiza kuomba, kutafuta na kubisha. Akishtakiwa kufukuza pepo kwa Beelzebuli, Yesu anazungumza kuhusu kidole cha Mungu na ishara ya Yona, na kuwalaumu Mafarisayo na wataalamu wa sheria wakati wa mlo.
11.am: ኢየሱስ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን መጸለይ ያስተምራቸዋል፤ እንዲለምኑ፣ እንዲፈልጉና እንዲያንኳኩም ያበረታታቸዋል። አጋንንትን በብዔልዜቡል ያስወጣል ተብሎ ሲከሰስ ኢየሱስ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ጣትና ስለ ዮናስ ምልክት ይናገራል፤ በማዕድ ላይም ፈሪሳውያንንና የሕግ አዋቂዎችን ይወቅሳል።

12.en: Jesus warns against the leaven of the Pharisees and tells of a rich fool who built bigger barns. The disciples are not to worry but to seek God's kingdom and to be like servants ready for their master's return.
12.sw: Yesu anaonya dhidi ya chachu ya Mafarisayo na kusimulia habari ya tajiri mpumbavu aliyejenga ghala kubwa zaidi. Wanafunzi hawapaswi kuwa na wasiwasi bali kuutafuta ufalme wa Mungu na kuwa kama watumishi walio tayari kwa kurudi kwa bwana wao.
12.am: ኢየሱስ ከፈሪሳውያን እርሾ እንዲጠነቀቁ ያስጠነቅቃል፤ ትልልቅ ጎተራዎችን ስለ ሠራው ሰነፍ ባለ ጠጋም ይናገራል። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ከመጨነቅ ይልቅ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት መፈለግና የጌታቸውን መመለስ ተዘጋጅተው እንደሚጠብቁ አገልጋዮች መሆን አለባቸው።

13.en: Jesus calls all to repent and tells of a fig tree given one more year. On the Sabbath Jesus heals a woman bent over for eighteen years, compares the kingdom to a mustard seed and yeast, urges striving to enter the narrow door, and laments over Jerusalem.
13.sw: Yesu anawaita wote watubu na kusimulia habari ya mtini uliopewa mwaka mmoja zaidi. Siku ya Sabato Yesu anamponya mwanamke aliyepinda kwa miaka kumi na minane, analinganisha ufalme na mbegu ya haradali na chachu, anahimiza kujitahidi kuingia kupitia mlango mwembamba, na kuomboleza juu ya Yerusalemu.
13.am: ኢየሱስ ሁሉም ንስሓ እንዲገቡ ይጠራል፤ አንድ ዓመት ተጨማሪ ጊዜ ስለ ተሰጣት በለስም ይናገራል። በሰንበት ኢየሱስ ለዐሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ጐብጣ የኖረችን ሴት ይፈውሳል፤ መንግሥቱን ከሰናፍጭ ቅንጣትና ከእርሾ ጋር ያነጻጽራል፤ በጠባቡ በር ለመግባት እንዲጋደሉ ያሳስባል፤ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌምም ያለቅሳል።

14.en: At a Sabbath meal Jesus heals a man with dropsy and teaches guests to take the lowest place and hosts to invite those who cannot repay. The parable of the great dinner is followed by a call to count the cost of following.
14.sw: Katika mlo wa Sabato Yesu anamponya mtu mwenye istiska na kuwafundisha wageni kuchukua nafasi ya chini kabisa na wenyeji kuwaalika wale wasioweza kulipa. Mfano wa karamu kubwa unafuatwa na mwito wa kuhesabu gharama ya kumfuata.
14.am: በሰንበት ማዕድ ላይ ኢየሱስ በውኃ እብጠት የተያዘውን ሰው ይፈውሳል፤ እንግዶች የመጨረሻውን ስፍራ እንዲይዙ፣ ጋባዦችም ብድር መመለስ የማይችሉትን እንዲጠሩ ያስተምራል። ከታላቁ ግብዣ ምሳሌ በኋላ እርሱን የመከተልን ዋጋ እንዲያሰሉ ጥሪ ይቀርባል።

15.en: When Pharisees and scribes grumble that Jesus welcomes sinners, Jesus tells of a lost sheep, a lost coin and a lost son. The father welcomes the younger son home and pleads with the resentful older son.
15.sw: Mafarisayo na waandishi wanaponung'unika kwamba Yesu anawakaribisha wenye dhambi, Yesu anasimulia habari ya kondoo aliyepotea, sarafu iliyopotea na mwana aliyepotea. Baba anamkaribisha nyumbani mwana mdogo na kumsihi mwana mkubwa aliye na uchungu.
15.am: ፈሪሳውያንና የሕግ መምህራን ኢየሱስ ኃጢአተኞችን ይቀበላል ብለው ሲያጉረመርሙ፣ ኢየሱስ ስለ ጠፋው በግ፣ ስለ ጠፋው ሳንቲምና ስለ ጠፋው ልጅ ይናገራል። አባቱ ታናሹን ልጅ ወደ ቤት ይቀበለዋል፤ የተቀየመውንም ታላቁን ልጅ ይለምነዋል።

16.en: Jesus tells of a shrewd manager and teaches that no one can serve both God and money. The Pharisees, who love money, are warned, and Jesus tells of a rich man and a poor man named Lazarus.
16.sw: Yesu anasimulia habari ya msimamizi mjanja na kufundisha kwamba hakuna awezaye kumtumikia Mungu na mali pia. Mafarisayo, wanaopenda fedha, wanaonywa, naye Yesu anasimulia habari ya tajiri mmoja na maskini aitwaye Lazaro.
16.am: ኢየሱስ ስለ ብልኁ መጋቢ ይናገራል፤ ማንም እግዚአብሔርንና ሀብትን በአንድነት ማገልገል እንደማይችልም ያስተምራል። ገንዘብ የሚወዱት ፈሪሳውያን ማስጠንቀቂያ ይሰጣቸዋል፤ ኢየሱስም ስለ አንድ ባለ ጠጋና አልዓዛር ስለሚባል ድሃ ይናገራል።

17.en: Jesus teaches about causing others to stumble, forgiveness and faith. Of ten men healed of leprosy only a Samaritan returns to give thanks, and Jesus speaks of the kingdom of God and the day the Son of Man is revealed.
17.sw: Yesu anafundisha kuhusu kuwakwaza wengine, msamaha na imani. Kati ya watu kumi walioponywa ukoma ni Msamaria peke yake anayerudi kushukuru, naye Yesu anazungumza kuhusu ufalme wa Mungu na siku Mwana wa Adamu atakapofunuliwa.
17.am: ኢየሱስ ሌሎችን ስለ ማሰናከል፣ ስለ ይቅርታና ስለ እምነት ያስተምራል። ከለምጽ ከተፈወሱት ዐሥር ሰዎች መካከል ለማመስገን የሚመለሰው ሳምራዊው ብቻ ነው፤ ኢየሱስም ስለ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥትና የሰው ልጅ ስለሚገለጥበት ቀን ይናገራል።

18.en: Jesus tells of a widow who would not stop asking and of a Pharisee and a tax collector praying in the temple. Jesus welcomes the children, answers a rich leader, foretells death and rising, and gives sight to a blind man near Jericho.
18.sw: Yesu anasimulia habari ya mjane asiyeacha kuomba, na ya Farisayo na mtoza ushuru wakiomba hekaluni. Yesu anawakaribisha watoto, anamjibu kiongozi tajiri, anatabiri kifo na kufufuka kwake, na kumpa kipofu karibu na Yeriko uwezo wa kuona.
18.am: ኢየሱስ መለመን ስላላቋረጠች መበለትና በቤተ መቅደስ ስለ ጸለዩ ፈሪሳዊና ቀራጭ ይናገራል። ኢየሱስ ሕፃናትን ይቀበላል፣ ለባለ ጠጋው አለቃ ይመልሳል፣ ሞቱንና መነሣቱን አስቀድሞ ይናገራል፣ በኢያሪኮ አቅራቢያም ለዕውሩ ዓይኑን ያበራለታል።

19.en: In Jericho Zacchaeus climbs a tree to see Jesus and becomes a changed man. Jesus tells of ten servants entrusted with minas, rides into Jerusalem on a colt, weeps over the city and drives the traders out of the temple.
19.sw: Huko Yeriko Zakayo anapanda mti ili amwone Yesu na kuwa mtu aliyebadilika. Yesu anasimulia habari ya watumishi kumi waliokabidhiwa mina, anaingia Yerusalemu akiwa amempanda mwana-punda, analia juu ya mji na kuwafukuza wafanyabiashara kutoka hekaluni.
19.am: በኢያሪኮ ዘኬዎስ ኢየሱስን ለማየት ዛፍ ላይ ይወጣል፤ ሕይወቱም ይለወጣል። ኢየሱስ ምናን ስለ ተሰጣቸው ዐሥር ባሪያዎች ይናገራል፣ በውርንጫ ተቀምጦ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይገባል፣ ስለ ከተማይቱ ያለቅሳል፣ ነጋዴዎችንም ከቤተ መቅደሱ ያባርራል።

20.en: The leaders question Jesus's authority, and Jesus tells of the tenant farmers who killed the owner's son. Jesus answers questions about paying tribute to Caesar and about the resurrection, and asks how David's son can be David's Lord.
20.sw: Viongozi wanahoji mamlaka ya Yesu, naye Yesu anasimulia habari ya wakulima waliomuua mwana wa mwenye shamba. Yesu anajibu maswali kuhusu kulipa kodi kwa Kaisari na kuhusu ufufuo, na kuuliza jinsi mwana wa Daudi anavyoweza kuwa Bwana wa Daudi.
20.am: መሪዎቹ የኢየሱስን ሥልጣን ይጠይቃሉ፤ ኢየሱስም የባለቤቱን ልጅ ስለ ገደሉት ተከራዮች ይናገራል። ኢየሱስ ለቄሳር ግብር ስለ መክፈልና ስለ ትንሣኤ ለቀረቡለት ጥያቄዎች ይመልሳል፤ የዳዊት ልጅ እንዴት የዳዊት ጌታ ሊሆን እንደሚችልም ይጠይቃል።

21.en: Jesus praises a poor widow's gift and foretells the temple's fall, Jerusalem surrounded by armies, and the Son of Man coming in a cloud. The disciples are to learn from the fig tree and stay awake and pray.
21.sw: Yesu anasifu sadaka ya mjane maskini na kutabiri kuanguka kwa hekalu, Yerusalemu kuzungukwa na majeshi, na Mwana wa Adamu akija katika wingu. Wanafunzi wanapaswa kujifunza kutoka kwa mtini na kukesha na kuomba.
21.am: ኢየሱስ የድሃይቱን መበለት ስጦታ ያመሰግናል፤ የቤተ መቅደሱን መፍረስ፣ ኢየሩሳሌም በሠራዊት መከበቧንና የሰው ልጅ በደመና መምጣቱን አስቀድሞ ይናገራል። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ከበለሲቱ ሊማሩ፣ ነቅተውም ሊጸልዩ ይገባቸዋል።

22.en: Judas agrees to hand Jesus over, and at the Passover meal Jesus gives the bread and the cup to the apostles and teaches that the greatest is the one who serves. Jesus prays on the Mount of Olives, is arrested, denied three times by Peter, mocked and questioned by the council.
22.sw: Yuda anakubali kumsaliti Yesu, na katika mlo wa Pasaka Yesu anawapa mitume mkate na kikombe na kufundisha kwamba aliye mkuu kuliko wote ni yule anayetumikia. Yesu anaomba katika Mlima wa Mizeituni, anakamatwa, anakanwa mara tatu na Petro, anadhihakiwa na kuhojiwa na Baraza Kuu.
22.am: ይሁዳ ኢየሱስን አሳልፎ ሊሰጥ ይስማማል፤ በፋሲካው ራት ኢየሱስ ለሐዋርያት እንጀራውንና ጽዋውን ይሰጣል፤ ከሁሉ የሚበልጠው የሚያገለግለው እንደ ሆነም ያስተምራል። ኢየሱስ በደብረ ዘይት ይጸልያል፣ ይያዛል፣ ጴጥሮስ ሦስት ጊዜ ይክደዋል፣ ይዘበትበታል፣ በሸንጎውም ይመረመራል።

23.en: Pilate and Herod find no guilt in Jesus, but the crowd asks for Barabbas, and Jesus is crucified at the Skull between two criminals, promising one of them paradise. Darkness falls, Jesus dies, and Joseph of Arimathea lays the body in a tomb.
23.sw: Pilato na Herode hawamwoni Yesu na hatia, lakini umati unaomba Baraba aachiliwe, naye Yesu anasulubiwa mahali panapoitwa Fuvu kati ya wahalifu wawili, akimwahidi mmoja wao paradiso. Giza linaingia, Yesu anakufa, na Yosefu wa Arimathaya analaza mwili kaburini.
23.am: ጲላጦስና ሄሮድስ በኢየሱስ ላይ በደል አያገኙበትም፤ ሕዝቡ ግን በርባን እንዲፈታ ይለምናል፤ ኢየሱስም የራስ ቅል በሚባለው ስፍራ በሁለት ወንጀለኞች መካከል ይሰቀላል፤ ለአንዱም ገነትን ተስፋ ይሰጠዋል። ጨለማ ይወርዳል፣ ኢየሱስ ይሞታል፤ የአርማትያሱ ዮሴፍም ሥጋውን በመቃብር ያኖረዋል።

24.en: Women find the tomb empty and are told that Jesus has been raised. The risen Jesus walks with two disciples to Emmaus, appears to the others with flesh and bones, opens the Scriptures to them, and is taken up near Bethany.
24.sw: Wanawake wanakuta kaburi tupu na kuambiwa kwamba Yesu amefufuliwa. Yesu aliyefufuka anatembea pamoja na wanafunzi wawili kwenda Emau, anawatokea wengine akiwa na nyama na mifupa, anawafunulia Maandiko, na kuchukuliwa juu karibu na Bethania.
24.am: ሴቶች መቃብሩን ባዶ ሆኖ ያገኙታል፤ ኢየሱስ እንደ ተነሣም ይነገራቸዋል። ከሙታን የተነሣው ኢየሱስ ከሁለት ደቀ መዛሙርት ጋር ወደ ኤማሁስ ይጓዛል፤ ሥጋና አጥንት ይዞ ለሌሎቹ ይገለጣል፣ መጻሕፍትን ይገልጥላቸዋል፣ በቢታንያ አቅራቢያም ወደ ላይ ይወሰዳል።
